en.p: Five coins are placed in a row on a table. Of these 5 coins, the coins in the 1st and 2nd positions show heads, and the 3 coins in the remaining positions show tails. Using these 5 coins and one die, the following trial is performed.

box: Roll the die once; let $k$ be the number rolled.
If $k\le 5$, flip the coin in the $k$th position once and put it back in place;
if $k=6$, flip every coin once and put each back in place.

en.p: After repeating this trial 3 times, the probability that all 5 coins show heads is $\dfrac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
